candidates.name: Room Beacon
candidates.model: A forehead-first, group-visible shared board with one holder commit, an equal blind tap path, explicit sensor recovery, and a separate truth-review panel.

candidates.name: Private Relay
candidates.model: A tap-first, role-explicit private relay with protected handoff, predictable recovery, and the same score and truth-review semantics as the selected direction.

protocol.sessionProfile: Six moderated proposed friend-group sessions, including role-appropriate screen-reader and non-motion participant evidence; exact owners, devices, conditions, and approved cards must be frozen before signing.

scenarios.description: Using the prepared neutral prompt and median-length fixture card, the group identifies roles and reaches one valid answer without moderator explanation.
scenarios.successCriteria: The group reaches one intended answer with no role, control, score, or privacy misunderstanding and without an avoidable restart.

scenarios.description: The group reads short, median, and maximum-length fixture cards across frozen viewing conditions, then recovers from a sensor, interruption, or orientation failure.
scenarios.successCriteria: Statement, attribution, context, and essential controls remain understandable; recovery records one intended answer without duplicate commit or card disclosure.

scenarios.description: Participants explain completed truth states, inspect reasonable captures, and complete the frozen tap-only, screen-reader, no-motion, offline, report, and protected-handoff paths.
scenarios.successCriteria: Truth and game context are explained correctly, pre-reveal captures do not imply authenticity, and every role-appropriate access path preserves task, score, review, and privacy semantics.

killCriteria.observationPrompt: Did any participant misstate completed truth meaning or treat a pre-reveal capture as an authentic public statement rather than a game round?
killCriteria.rationale: One truth or context misunderstanding can create false-attribution harm, so the selected direction must stop rather than normalize the risk.

killCriteria.observationPrompt: Did the selected candidate fail a role-appropriate primary path without recovery, including setup, commit, accessibility, review, report, or protected handoff?
killCriteria.rationale: Two unrecovered selected-direction failures show a repeated structural problem rather than an isolated facilitation or device anomaly.

limitations: This plan is unsigned and may not be used for participant sessions until an independent reviewer signs the unchanged file with the external private key.
The shared fixture still requires accountable editorial approval of actual study cards and research-lead freezing of devices, distances, environment, and capture procedure.
Six formative group sessions can expose severe risks and compare the two models but cannot establish population-level effectiveness or legal clearance.
